summary: Onosys provides an enterprise digital-ordering platform for multi-unit restaurant brands, including online ordering, third-party marketplace management (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Skip the Dishes), call-center technology, and catering management; named restaurant customers include Pizza Ranch, Chop Stop, Winking Lizard Tavern, Beggars Pizza, Mr. Hero, Giordano's, Rudy's Bar-B-Q, Jefferson's, and Dion's.

Chris Anderle was promoted to Chief Executive Officer and President of Onosys on April 28, 2026, to lead the company's next phase of growth, following a company 'relaunch' announced in February 2026. (Scope note: Exact details of the February 2026 'relaunch' (e.g., new ownership, rebrand scope) were not independently confirmed beyond the company's own site references.)

Onosys appears in PAR Technology's partner ecosystem listing, indicating an active integration/partnership relationship with PAR's POS platform, though no direct acquisition of Onosys by PAR Technology was confirmed. (Scope note: This confirms a technology partnership only, not ownership; do not assume PAR Technology owns Onosys.)
